title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-10-09
headline: Ghana starts enforcing a ban on preaching inside moving buses

questions.prompt: Who often preaches on long-distance buses in Ghana?
choices: Pastors who ride with the passengers
questions.hintKo: Pastors commonly preach on public buses in Ghana.

hintI18n.en: Pastors commonly preach on public buses in Ghana.
